question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**visits**" is the most appropriate to use in this context.
 
• Charlie "**visits**" the chocolate factory with his grandfather, which means they go to see and explore it.
 
• "**Explores**" means to travel through an area to learn about it, which is close but not as specific to the context as** "visits".**
 
• "**Inspects**" means to examine carefully, especially for errors or problems, which doesn't fit the situation as well.
 
• "**Examines**" means to look at something carefully and in detail, which is also not as contextually appropriate as** "visits".**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He visits__ it with his grandfather.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Explores**: This means to travel through an area for discovery, which is less specific than "visits".
 
• **Inspects**: This means to look at something closely to judge its condition or quality, which is not what Charlie and his grandfather are doing.
 
• **Examines**: This means to investigate or look at something in detail, which is not as fitting as simply "visits".
